preconditions.description: The length of the array a is between 3 and 10^5.
Each element of the array a is a positive integer.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if it is possible to make all elements equal, or 'NO' if it is impossible.
If the output is 'YES', then the number of operations m is between 0 and n.

postconditions.expression: if output == 'YES': all(a_i == a_j for i, j in operations)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then after performing the operations, all elements of the array a are equal.
If the output is 'YES', then the number of operations m is equal to the number of lines in the operations section.

postconditions.expression: if output == 'YES': all(1 <= i, j, k <= n for i, j, k in operations)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then each operation selects three distinct indices from 1 to n.
If the output is 'NO', then no operations are performed.
